subject.title: fix(infra): make exec-approvals lock ownership filesystem-safe

question: Which open PR should be the canonical fix for the exec-approvals VirtioFS lock leak, and should its current head be accepted only after exact-head runtime proof?
rationale: Both this PR and the related open PR implement the same security-sensitive lock correction; choosing a canonical branch and accepting proof for its exact SHA requires maintainer ownership and contributor-credit judgment.

options.title: Adopt this rebased branch after proof
options.body: Keep this PR as the canonical candidate only after a redacted current-head VirtioFS run proves cleanup and fail-closed contention behavior.

options.title: Advance the original related branch
options.body: Prefer the related PR if its existing implementation and original authorship are retained, then request proof against its current head.

options.title: Pause both for a consolidated owner patch
options.body: Close neither branch until an owner consolidates the desired lock contract and validation into one maintained candidate.

recommendation.title: Adopt this rebased branch after proof
recommendation.body: Keep this PR as the canonical candidate only after a redacted current-head VirtioFS run proves cleanup and fail-closed contention behavior.

likelyOwner.reason: They supplied the production reproduction and authored the overlapping original implementation candidate.
